discover_tools: standalone read-only action, empty target, args {query?:string,names?:string[]}. Returns actual typed command definitions and relevant skills; those commands become available in the next planning step. Query a category or exact names. If a needed tool is absent from your current schema, discover it before claiming it does not exist. Discovery never grants new permissions or applies changes.

configure_environment: target owned world; args {night?:bool,stars?:0..4000,sky_color?:[r,g,b,a],light_intensity?:0..8,seed?:integer}. Set scene camera backgrounds and owned directional light; create a persistent star mesh that follows the camera. Repeated calls replace the previous starfield. Works for any world, no collision on sky.
configure_audio: target existing owned object; args {clip:string,volume?:0..1,loop?:bool,spatial?:bool}. Existing imported AudioClip asset path only, not an invented URL; adds AudioSource and playOnAwake.
verify_scene: standalone read-only, empty target, args {checks:[{target:string,kind:component|active|mesh|terrain_height|path,type?:string,expected?:number,to?:string}]}. Independent live read-back: component uses full type/name, mesh checks saved vertices and collision, terrain_height compares sample at target center against expected metres, path checks actual NavMesh PathComplete. A failed assertion returns a failed tool result, not a successful narrative.
reflect_api: empty target; args {type:string,member?:string}. Read public Unity/project C# signatures before using unfamiliar APIs. No method invocation.
execute_editor_code: optional existing owned target, otherwise an owned workspace; args {code:string}. Standalone C# METHOD BODY (optional leading using directives are supported; no namespace or class declarations), at most 20000 characters, ending with return object/anonymous data. Usings System, Collections.Generic, Linq, UnityEngine, UnityEditor, WorldWeaver, Newtonsoft.Json.Linq are supplied. Parameter GameObject target is the real object/workspace; use it instead of inventing an ID. Requires the project's autonomous Editor C# setting. Compiles with real Roslyn diagnostics, then executes immediately on Unity main thread with full Editor permissions. Use Undo for every edit, keep new scene objects under target, create persistent runtime assets under Assets/WorldWeaverGenerated only. Review the automatic sceneReadback and geometric warnings against the request before finishing. Joint.anchor and Collider.center are LOCAL coordinates; use TransformPoint/InverseTransformPoint when comparing with WORLD bounds. Return actual measured state. No infinite loops, sleeps, network, shell, secret access, unrelated deletion, scene replacement, or claims of play verification. Runtime MonoBehaviours need saved source and normal compilation; dynamic snippet types cannot be serialized as runtime scripts.
find_unity_recipes: empty target; args {query:string,limit?:1..8}. Search the pinned MIT Unity C#/API recipe library by operation, type or domain. Returns actual IDs, signatures and references, not executable tool names. Search English API terms if Russian search is empty.
read_unity_recipe: empty target; args {id:string,offset?:integer}. Read hash-verified Markdown/C# reference, up to 9000 characters per page. Follow nextOffset and prerequisite IDs. Source templates use another IRunCommand host; adapt API code to our actual tools, never call nonexistent source MCP commands.
create_world: name; target empty. args {style?:alpine|forest|desert|moon,width?:32..2048,length?:32..2048,height?:4..512,trees?:0..300,buildings?:0..100,rocks?:0..300,seed?:integer,resolution?:33|65|129|257|513,scale?:0.1..32,octaves?:1..8,persistence?:0.1..0.9,lacunarity?:1..4,mountainStrength?:0.0..1.0,valleyDepth?:0.0..0.8,waterLevel?:0.0..0.8,southSlope?:0.0..1.0,smoothingPasses?:0..8}. Width,length,height are METRES. valleyDepth,waterLevel,mountainStrength,southSlope are NORMALIZED FRACTIONS, not metres; valleyDepth and waterLevel must not exceed 0.8. Partial TerrainSpec has consistent defaults: keep optional terrain noise/water factors at defaults unless the user asks to change them. Creates textured terrain,lake,spaced trees/rocks/houses,sun and camera. Preserves all existing scene objects. Presets alter geometry and colors; these are original low-poly primitives, not imported art.
update_world: target owned world or terrain. args same partial TerrainSpec fields and optional style. Rebuilds heights/ground layers/water, keeps existing contents anchored to new ground. To lower mountains use mountainStrength or height. Does not add/remove decoration.
inspect_object: target; args {}. Read-back of transform,components,TerrainSpec,NPC and inventory.
search_project: target empty; args {query:text,limit?:1..40}. Read-only asset search under Assets/Packages.

# Воспроизводимая генерация мира по seed и пространственным ограничениям

## Рабочий подход
1. Сначала выбери и назови масштаб: для открытого мира ориентир 512–2048 м, 64–256 м — компактный прототип; явные размеры пользователя имеют приоритет. Сохраняй seed и параметры.
2. Проверяй slope, воду, пересечения, плотность и бюджет до создания; ограничивай число попыток placement, иначе плотный мир зависнет.
3. Проверка: тот же seed и настройки воспроизводят размещение, точные количества достигнуты либо есть объяснение ограничений; объекты имеют опору и проходимые промежутки.
